svg.metadata: Short-node redraw of the methods, technical route and experiment plan in the publicly readable copy of Changqing Xu's 2003 CaSR proposal. Same title, PI and institution verified in the 2003 funded-project list on the Chinese Academy of Sciences Life Sciences journal website, PDF page 12. Funding status also confirmed by the author's public statement; award 30370577 cross-checked against the public project-list mirror and a publication funding acknowledgment. Not a facsimile of the original route; proposed mechanisms are research aims, not established outcomes. See references/funded-cases.md.
